display_long_description:
A solo-developed sci-fi wave shooter for Meta Quest. Laser Handgun in one hand, holo-shield in the other. Fight drone waves. Chase the score.

# Handgun
- **Skill venting** — gun overheats instead of reloading. Flick it at the right moment to cool fast.
- **Canting** — holding the gun non tilted builds heat faster. Aim properly.
- **Amplify** — aim behind your own shield to boost your damage. Costs shield health. Worth it.

# Shield
- **Glancing deflection** — keep it moving, shots glance off harmlessly.
- **Kinetic cushioning** — pull against  an incoming shot to absorb impact.
- **Parry & reflect** — swing fast and face it right — projectiles fire back at enemies.
- **Vulnerable state** — Amplify leaves the shield exposed. Incoming hits land harder.

# Dodge
Physically dodge with your body.  Get close. Stay mobile.

# Score
- **Style Rank (D → S)** — decays over time. Reflects and dodges push it up. Damage drops it.
- **Combo Multiplier (×1 → ×5)** — stack it. Every hit multiplies.
- **Distance scaling** — closer enemies are worth more.

# Early Access v0.5 — 3 levels · 3 difficulties · 3 loadouts
Play the build, push the mechanics to the breaking point, and leave your raw feedback in the reviews. Your input will directly dictate the development roadmap and the future of the game!

Make sure to join the Discord server!
https://discord.com/invite/fra3CwHyx8
